generated_output.summary: The automated domain/ley-line navigation logic for claiming rewards at ancient trees involves dragging the screen while walking. Due to this screen dragging behavior, characters can drift off course, walk into map edges or the abyss, resulting in failed runs and task timeouts. The user requests an option to configure or disable screen dragging during ancient tree reward collection.
generated_output.root_cause_analysis: The game automation workflow unconditionally invokes screen dragging during navigation steps (e.g., using mouse drag functions in visual flow execution like BvFlow) without a conditional check against user configuration preferences to disable the drag behavior.

step_by_step_plan.title: Inspect screen dragging logic in BvFlow.cs
step_by_step_plan.description: Examine block_526 and surrounding methods in BetterGenshinImpact/Core/BgiVision/BvFlow.cs to identify where mouse drag commands are executed during ancient tree reward collection and domain navigation.

step_by_step_plan.title: Introduce configuration check for screen dragging
step_by_step_plan.description: Add a configuration setting toggle in the application settings system and incorporate a conditional check before invoking screen drag actions in BvFlow.cs.

step_by_step_plan.title: Implement bypass for screen dragging when disabled
step_by_step_plan.description: Update the navigation flow execution logic in BvFlow.cs to bypass or skip mouse drag operations when the new user configuration option is turned off, preventing character drift.

step_by_step_plan.title: Run regression tests and verify behavior
step_by_step_plan.description: Execute the test suite to verify that domain navigation functions correctly both with screen dragging enabled and disabled.

structured_concepts.short_explanation: A user-adjustable setting in the configuration model that toggles a specific feature on or off.
structured_concepts.why_it_matters: Allows automation scripts to adapt to different character heights and environment behaviors without hardcoding assumptions.
structured_concepts.connection_to_issue: Enables users to turn off screen dragging during ancient tree navigation if it causes their characters to drift into map boundaries.

structured_concepts.short_explanation: A framework for sequencing visual automation steps including clicks, mouse movements, dragging, and condition waiting.
structured_concepts.why_it_matters: Manages how automated game actions are chained together into coherent task sequences.
structured_concepts.connection_to_issue: The ancient tree finding routine executes drag actions through this flow system, which needs to be conditionally bypassed based on configuration.

common_pitfalls: Modifying global mouse drag behavior across all automated tasks instead of scoping the option specifically to the domain reward / ancient tree finding step.
Forgetting to update UI settings bindings when adding a new configuration property.
